visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short brown hair and a white hoodie is in a brightly lit indoor studio. He raises his wrist to show an Apple Watch while gesturing with his other hand towards the camera. (2) The man holds up a small, gray, palm-sized drone with four protected propellers, identified by a logo. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face. (3) Transitions to an outdoor park setting where a hand launches the drone into the air. A close-up shows the Apple Watch displaying a live video feed from the drone. (4) Back indoors, the man continues his explanation, pointing at the drone. (5) On the Apple Watch screen, various menu icons for following modes like cycling and running are shown. (6) In the park, the man sits on the ground near a tripod-mounted smartphone, smiling and giving a peace sign while the drone hovers nearby. (7) The man is seen jogging along a paved path in a green park; he stops to look at his watch and then gives a thumbs up. (8) He is back in the studio, holding the drone and pointing to its features. (9) He sits on the grass outdoors using a remote controller with an integrated screen to fly the drone. (10) A series of aerial shots show a city skyline with a large IKEA building, a highway interchange with moving traffic, and a river winding through green space and high-rise buildings under a blue sky.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy electronic pop music starts. A clear, articulate male voice speaks enthusiastically in Mandarin about Apple Watch capabilities. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect transitions into a slightly louder BGM layer as the speaker introduces the DJI Neo 2. (3) Soft outdoor ambient wind and the distinct high-pitched whine of drone rotors are heard. A digital 'ding' sounds as the speaker interacts with a watch screen. (4) The speaker says 'Hey Fly', and a brief digital UI beep follows. A synthesized female voice replies 'Please speak' in Mandarin. (5) The music continues at a steady 124 BPM as the speaker narrates scenarios like cycling and jogging. (6) Another transition SFX occurs as the energy remains high for the final recommendation and festive gift suggestion. (7) Music fades out over a panoramic drone shot with no further speech.
